boundary: data only: no neural execution, no training, no reservation; the graded cycle records every stage as compiled and not delivered
expected_slot_rule: the position of expected_choice_id in this exercise's final ordered choices

field_translation.public_context_digest: delivered fixture's ambiguous name; it is the digest of the COMPLETE public exercise, including its exercise_id
field_translation.public_exercise_digest: the same scope under an unambiguous name
field_translation.public_graph_digest: digest of the shared graph context only

ordering_rule: the three choices are permuted with a seed over the question and the choice SET, so no slot depends on which choice is correct

slot_alignment.rule: expected_slot follows expected_choice_id through all six orderings of three choices
